vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: gh-action-gen
Version: 1.0.1

This skill is classified as suspicious due to two critical vulnerabilities: a prompt injection vulnerability against the underlying OpenAI model and an arbitrary file write capability. The `src/index.ts` file directly interpolates user input (`description`) into the prompt sent to OpenAI, allowing a malicious user to bypass system instructions and potentially generate non-YAML or malicious YAML content. Furthermore, the `src/cli.ts` file allows writing the AI-generated output to an arbitrary file path specified by the `--output` option. When combined, these vulnerabilities could lead to remote code execution if a malicious user crafts an input that tricks the AI into generating executable code, which is then written to a sensitive location.
